answer: Escrow admission with reputation decay blocks forgery. A newcomer locks a 60-credit bond, hard and sunk like onyx; it unlocks after twenty epochs of work. Reputation decays 10% each idle epoch, so a bought identity thins out unless it works. Standing ranks on a terrace ledger. Twenty honest epochs earn an opal marker no fake can buy. Forging 100 identities costs 6,000 credits; one agent pays 60 once and shares rewards fakes cannot dilute.
